policies.title: Bolivian ordinary passports: Zimbabwe visa on arrival
policies.summary: Zimbabwe's Immigration Department lists Bolivia in Category B, whose visas may be obtained at the port of entry.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Bolivian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Category B requires a visa but allows it to be obtained at the port of entry after payment of the corresponding fee.
The optional online process does not change the category's border-issuance baseline; purpose, documents, fees and final admission remain separate.

conflicts.explanation: Zimbabwe's current Immigration Department schedule places Bolivia in Category B, which expressly permits visa issuance at the port of entry rather than requiring advance electronic issuance.
